root_cause: The hide method restores focus before removing the focus trap listener, causing the listener to return focus to the dialog after attempting to focus the opener.
repair_strategy: Reorder the hide method to remove the focus and keydown listeners before restoring focus to the previously focused element.
expected_accessibility_effect: Focus returns to the button that opened the dialog when the dialog is closed with Escape, allowing keyboard users to resume interaction with the underlying page.
functional_risks: Potential reliance on listeners being present during focus restoration (unlikely).
verification_requirements: Verify that pressing Escape on the dialog returns focus to the opener.
Verify that opening and closing via mouse clicks still works.
Verify that focus trapping remains effective while the dialog is open.
